_readme: Where each value is stamped onto INFINITY RIO RANCH - Vendor Agreement.pdf.
Same deal as the rental agreement's agreement-fields.json, and the same
warning: the template has NO form fields, so every value sits at a fixed
coordinate measured from the document's own text and rules. RE-EXPORT THE
TEMPLATE AND ALL OF THESE ARE SILENTLY WRONG — a vendor receives a contract
with their phone number across a table rule and nothing errors. Run
`node scripts/vendor-agreement-preview.mjs` and LOOK at the output after any
change to either file.
Origin is bottom-left, PDF points, page is 594.96 x 841.92 (three pages).
This document is drawn, not typeset: every glyph in it is a Type3 procedure,
so there is no embedded font to reuse and no ToUnicode-free way to match it.
Values are set in Helvetica — a neutral sans that sits closest to the
document's own geometric face without shipping a font file into the admin
bundle. Do not switch to Times: it would read as a different document.
Two shapes of field, because the template has two shapes of blank:
`underline` — the value sits ON a printed rule or underscore run, so `y`
is that rule's y plus a couple of points and the text is drawn from x.
`cell` — a boxed table cell whose tiny caps label is its own line; the
value goes on a second baseline under it, `labelY` minus 9.5. The cells
are only 28.5pt tall, so 9.5pt is the largest value that clears both
the label above and the rule below. Don't raise it.
`maxWidth` is how much room the value actually has before it hits the next
rule or column; longer values are shrunk to fit rather than running over.
Checkboxes are the four 8.2pt squares in SERVICE TYPE. They are drawn empty
by the template, so a chosen one gets an X centred in it — the box outline
belongs to the template and is never redrawn.
The keys here are the words the TEMPLATE prints — food, decoration, dj,
other — not the service names the panel offers. The panel works in the
venue's own vocabulary (Catering, Decor, DJ, Event Manager) and
vendor-agreement.ts maps each onto the box the document actually has:
catering ticks Food, decor ticks Decoration, and Event Manager ticks Other
and writes its name on the line beside it. Keep these keys matching the
printed labels — the day the template is redrawn with new words, this file
is where you look to see what it used to say.
Signature and date lines are deliberately left blank, exactly as the rental
agreement leaves them: nobody knows the signing date when the PDF is made,
and both parties sign by hand.
